dimensions.assessment: Affects aquaculture facility operators, state and federal fish hatcheries, and licensed private lake and pond managers in specified states.
dimensions.evidence: applies to... lake managers and pond managers in addition to and in the same manner as each of the entities to which the original depredation order applied

dimensions.assessment: Allows capturing, killing, or dispersing of cormorants without a permit to protect facilities and property.
dimensions.evidence: Depredation orders allow for the taking... of a specified species without a permit, generally to reduce damage caused by the species

dimensions.assessment: No specific federal appropriations are detailed, though agency administrative duties for reissuing and renewing orders are required.
Reissues and expands a specific federal wildlife regulation and mandates its renewal every five years.
dimensions.evidence: Not less than once every 5 years... the Secretary shall renew the depredation order

dimensions.assessment: Permanent requirement with mandatory reviews and renewals every five years.
dimensions.evidence: Not less than once every 5 years after the date on which the Secretary reissues the original depredation order... the Secretary shall renew

missing_information: Exact number of aquaculture facilities, lake managers, and pond managers newly covered
Biological or economic impact on cormorant populations and fish farming losses
importance_detail.rationale: Directs the Department of the Interior to reissue and periodically renew a depredation order allowing the taking of double-crested cormorants at aquaculture facilities in expanded states and for licensed private lake and pond managers.
